name: Methamphetamine
warning: High-dose / sleep-deprived presentation. Uses peripheral flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: extra crispness — the over-sharpened vigilant look (early sharpenHalo).
Light: visual snow visible on flat surfaces.
Common: texture crawl in flat regions + first peripheral corner flickers that vanish when the mouse approaches.
Strong: frequent shadow events, harsh contrast, cold desaturation.
Heavy: rare humanoid silhouettes at frame edge, constant crawl, snowstorm.
